headlines.headline: NBA strips Clippers of five first-round picks, fines Ballmer $30 million
headlines.detail: League concluded its salary-cap circumvention probe tied to Kawhi Leonard; one of the harshest penalties in league history.

headlines.headline: Packers RB Josh Jacobs remains on commissioner's exempt list
headlines.detail: Opened the season on the list after a May arrest later reduced to two misdemeanors; initial court date is Nov. 17.

headlines.headline: Texas stuns No. 1 Ohio State 24-23, erasing 20-point fourth-quarter deficit
headlines.detail: First AP No. 1 loss after a 20+ point 4th-quarter lead since 2004 (197-0 before Saturday); Texas jumps to No. 1.

headlines.headline: Florida, Illinois headline preseason Top 25 as transfer portal reshapes contenders
headlines.detail: Florida No. 1 in CBS's Top 25 And 1; Illinois debuts at No. 2 in FOX's poll, its highest preseason ranking since 1985.
